dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with REPLACING, INDEXED files, no EXEC SQL/CICS
evidence: no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) file creation for health insurance billing, specifically for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system handling insured patient billing data
purpose.summary: ORCR0104 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates print files for medical insurance receipts (レセプト印刷用ファイル作成). It reads multiple indexed receipt data files (RECE02, RECE031, RECE061, RECE09, RECE11), processes insurance billing records for patients, and writes output for receipt printing including handling of public expense (公費) claims.

notable_features: 52 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
111 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake display. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The // REPLACING delimiter style is characteristic of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but sufficient evidence exists for classification.
